title: Ted Owens wills an airliner to crash
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Ted Owens wills an airliner to crash, about unspecified at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And so he wills the plane ahead of them to crash and it does as a civilian airliner crash.

plain: A researcher and writer, Jason Jorjani, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 about a man named Ted Owens who, according to the story, used the power of his mind to make a passenger plane flying ahead of him and his companions crash, and it did. If true, it would mean a person's will alone could cause physical events at a distance.
